places-rio-frio-solana-del-molinico.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-rio-frio-solana-del-molinico.story: 175 km from Puebla de Don Fadrique to Puebla de Don Fadrique, about 3 h 01 of riding. It goes by way of Los Sacristanes, Fuensanta II, Solana del molinico and back through Fuensanta II. The highest point is about 1,450 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
